title: Finite étale Artinian residue capture data
statement: Let D and S be commutative local Artinian rings, with a local D-algebra structure on S. For every element b of the residue field of S separable over the residue field of D, there exist a finite étale local D-algebra D' and a local ring map g':D'→S factoring D→S, and d in D' whose image in the residue field of S is b. The Artinian property of D' is omitted because it follows from finite generation over the Artinian ring D.

source.place: Tag 07FI, finite étale extension and henselian factorization paragraphs

proof.text: Put k = κ(D), K = κ(S). Separability gives integrality and a monic separable minimal polynomial m of b. Lift m coefficientwise along the surjective residue map D→k, keeping it monic, using Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic. Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap and derivative_map give F(b)=0 and F'(b)≠0 from minpoly.aeval and IsSeparable.aeval_derivative_ne_zero.

Take the standard étale pair (F,F'), with identity F'·1+F·0=(F')^1. The standard étale algebra P.Ring is étale and P.lift sends its generator to b in K. Replace it by E=ULift P.Ring to meet the requested universe; Etale.of_equiv transports étaleness. Call the resulting D-algebra map ψ:E→K.

Étale E/D is essentially finite type and formally unramified, hence quasi-finite by the instance in Mathlib.RingTheory.Unramified.LocalStructure. Module.Finite.of_quasiFinite makes E finite over the Artinian D, and IsArtinianRing.of_finite makes E Artinian.

The maximal ideal of S equals its nilradical by Ring.KrullDimLE.nilradical_eq_maximalIdeal, and is nilpotent by IsArtinianRing.isNilpotent_nilradical. Formal smoothness of E/D lifts ψ across S→κ(S): g=FormallySmooth.lift, with residue(g(x))=ψ(x) by FormallySmooth.mk_lift.

Let q=ker ψ, a prime since K is a field, and D'=Localization.AtPrime q. IsArtinianRing.localization_surjective makes E→D' surjective, so Module.Finite.of_surjective gives finiteness over D. Over the Noetherian D, FinitePresentation.of_finiteType supplies finite presentation; localization preserves formal étaleness, so D'/D is étale.

For x outside q, ψ(x)≠0 implies g(x) is a unit by IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit. Extend g to g':D'→S using IsLocalization.liftAlgHom. To show g' local, represent any element by y in E using surjectivity; if g'(y) is a unit then ψ(y)≠0, so its image in D' is a unit by IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff. The algebra homomorphism identity supplies g'∘(D→D')=D→S; isLocalHom_of_comp and locality of D→S make D→D' local.

Take d to be the localized image of the lifted generator e.symm P.X. IsLocalization.lift_eq, FormallySmooth.mk_lift, and StandardEtalePair.lift_X give residue(g'(d))=b. This proves every conjunction with the original universes and hypotheses unchanged.
